toolList.name: calculator
toolList.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression exactly. Use it for any calculation instead of working it out yourself. Supports + - * / % ^, parentheses, sqrt, abs, round(x, digits), floor, ceil, min, max, pow, ln, log, exp, pi and e. Example: round(950000 * 0.12, 2).

expression.description: The expression to evaluate. Numbers without thousands separators.

toolList.name: current_datetime
toolList.description: Returns the current date, time and weekday, optionally in a given IANA time zone (for example Asia/Karachi). Defaults to UTC.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone name such as Asia/Karachi or Europe/London.

toolList.name: knowledge_search
toolList.description: Searches the organisation’s knowledge bases you have access to and returns the most relevant passages with their document titles. Use a focused query; search again with different words if the first results do not answer the question.

query.description: What to search for, in natural language.

toolList.name: send_email
toolList.description: Sends an email to a member of this workspace, identified by their email address. Only workspace members can receive it, and only if they are allowed to see the information in this conversation. Keep messages short and factual.

to.description: The member’s email address (a placeholder such as [EMAIL_ADDRESS_1] is fine).

nodeTypes.label: Trigger
nodeTypes.description: Where a run starts. Its output is the run input.

fields.name: inputSchema
fields.description: The run input’s shape. Default: { "input": string }.

nodeTypes.label: Agent
nodeTypes.description: Runs an agent on a task: retrieval through its knowledge bases, its granted tools, masking at the model boundary — all as the person who started the run.

fields.name: agentId
fields.description: The agent.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The task, e.g. "Summarise {{nodes.research.output}}". Default: the input it receives.

fields.name: useTools
fields.description: Offer the agent’s granted tools. Default true.

fields.name: maxToolIterations
fields.description: Tool calls this step may make, up to the agent’s own limit.

fields.name: output
fields.description: { "format": "text" } or { "format": "json", "schema": {…} } for fields later nodes can branch on.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Step timeout, up to WORKFLOW_STEP_TIMEOUT.

fields.name: retry
fields.description: { maxAttempts, backoffMs }: transient failures are retried with jittered exponential backoff.

nodeTypes.label: Tool
nodeTypes.description: Calls a tool directly with templated arguments. Place it after an approval node for tools that require approval.

fields.name: toolId
fields.description: The tool.

fields.name: arguments
fields.description: Literal JSON or templates; "{{nodes.a.output.count}}" keeps its type.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Step timeout, up to WORKFLOW_STEP_TIMEOUT.

fields.name: retry
fields.description: { maxAttempts, backoffMs }: transient failures are retried with jittered exponential backoff.

nodeTypes.label: Knowledge source
nodeTypes.description: Searches knowledge bases as the run’s initiator. Connect it to an agent, which reads the passages as reference material.

fields.name: query
fields.description: What to search for.

fields.name: knowledgeBaseIds
fields.description: Narrow the search to these bases.

fields.name: topK
fields.description: 1–20 passages.

nodeTypes.label: Condition
nodeTypes.description: Branches on data: the first matching rule’s handle is taken, else "else". A rule’s edge may loop back to an earlier node, with a maximum number of iterations.

fields.name: rules
fields.description: [{ id, value: template, operator, operand?, caseSensitive? }]

fields.name: rules[].operator
fields.description: How to compare.

nodeTypes.label: Supervisor
nodeTypes.description: Coordinates a team of agents (its "worker" edges): each round it chooses who acts next and what they should do, until the goal is met or the rounds run out.

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: llm: a model decides. round_robin: each worker in turn.

fields.name: agentId
fields.description: Persona for the supervisor’s decisions.

fields.name: goal
fields.description: The team’s goal. Default: the input it receives.

fields.name: maxRounds
fields.description: Worker turns at most, up to WORKFLOW_MAX_SUPERVISOR_ROUNDS.

nodeTypes.label: Approval
nodeTypes.description: Pauses the run until a member with workflow:approve (and clearance for the data) decides. Whoever started the run cannot approve it, unless allowed.

fields.name: message
fields.description: What approvers are asked.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Default WORKFLOW_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT.

fields.name: onTimeout
fields.description: Default reject.

fields.name: allowSelfApproval
fields.description: Default false (separation of duties).

nodeTypes.label: Output
nodeTypes.description: The run’s result. A run completes when an output node is reached.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Default: its predecessor’s output.
